title: paspalum cochinchinense
intro: Paspalum cochinchinense, commonly known as East Indian grass, is a type of plant native to Southeast Asia and other parts of the world. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Paspalum cochinchinense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents in this plant are believed to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its potential health benefits.
